name: Pascal Lewis
source: Born June 4, 213 FE, on the space colony Selene.  Pascal was drafted only a couple months before Wick arrives at the Nauvoo. A compassionate, gentle soul. Like Hosanna and Soo-jin, he pilots a Caspar B mech.
